WITH quarterly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
        d.CalendarYear AS calendar_year,
        d.CalendarQuarterLabel AS calendar_quarter,
        sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS quarter_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON fos.DateKey = d.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fos.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        d.CalendarYear,
        d.CalendarQuarterLabel
),
annual_sales AS (
    SELECT
        product_category,
        calendar_year,
        sum(quarter_sales) AS annual_sales
    FROM quarterly_sales
    GROUP BY
        product_category,
        calendar_year
),
category_quarter_dependence AS (
    SELECT
        qs.product_category,
        qs.calendar_year,
        qs.calendar_quarter,
        qs.quarter_sales,
        a.annual_sales,
        qs.quarter_sales / nullif(a.annual_sales, 0) AS quarter_share_of_annual_sales
    FROM quarterly_sales AS qs
    INNER JOIN annual_sales AS a
        ON qs.product_category = a.product_category
       AND qs.calendar_year = a.calendar_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_category,
        calendar_year,
        calendar_quarter,
        quarter_sales,
        annual_sales,
        quarter_share_of_annual_sales,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY product_category
            ORDER BY quarter_share_of_annual_sales DESC, calendar_year DESC, calendar_quarter
        ) AS rn
    FROM category_quarter_dependence
)
SELECT
    product_category,
    calendar_year,
    calendar_quarter AS most_important_quarter,
    quarter_sales,
    annual_sales,
    round(quarter_share_of_annual_sales * 100, 2) AS single_quarter_share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY single_quarter_share_pct DESC, product_category;
